title: M2 Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Schuberth M2 Matte Black is crafted for all-terrain explorers transitioning from tarmac to rugged single-track, pairing peak visor aerodynamic stability with high-flow dust filtration. Featuring a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) architecture at 1432g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~88 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Long Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with a glove-friendly Micro-Lock Ratchet retention system.

product_details.description: Premium adventure modular with S-Com ready and electric sun visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for adventure riding with a slightly larger internal volume; may require cheek pads adjustment for smaller heads.

technical_analysis: Features Direct Fiber Processing (DFP) glass fiber reinforced with carbon matrix tuned in Magdeburg acoustic wind tunnels paired with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna. The interior utilizes Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Schuberth M2 Matte Black: combining Germany 🇩🇪 craftsmanship with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna and Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Schuberth M2 Matte Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Schuberth M2 Matte Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Long Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Schuberth's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the M2 Matte Black brings German engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Long Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Schuberth M2 Matte Black represents Schuberth's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to a Long Oval head shape, the Schuberth M2 Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
